old_batch.name: Parku i Qytetit
old_batch.place_assessment: Parku i Qytetit means City Park in Prishtina's Velani neighbourhood. Gays-Cruising has a dated Oct 5 2025 comment explicitly saying author had NOT visited for five years, hence not current firsthand activity. Crucial 2024 ethnographic research from Kosovo's Centre for Equality and Liberty documents the park was an important cruising place after 2001, a gay man was murdered in the park in 2008, and subsequent fear prompted community to shift to a different unpublicized meeting place. Study deliberately protects active location anonymity. Do NOT infer the current protected location or describe this park as currently safe/active. Geo metadata in source wrongly 'Kosovo Serbia', not city name.
